settings.title: The questions that shape the trip

settings.editor: Useful answers need verified sources and practical context, not generic filler.

tabs.tab_title: How do I choose a national park?
tabs.tab_content: Compare season, accessibility, travel time, activities and park-specific NPS guidance. Browse all 63 national park records first.

tabs.tab_title: Where can I find hotels and restaurants near Zion?
tabs.tab_content: Open the dedicated Zion hotel and dining pages for named research candidates, geographic context and source links. Precise 25-mile verification remains in progress.

tabs.tab_title: Do all National Parks require the same permits?
tabs.tab_content: No. Entrance rules, restricted hikes and permit systems differ by park and season. Use each park's official NPS planning guidance.

tabs.tab_title: Can I earn passport rewards or buy souvenirs here today?
tabs.tab_content: Not yet. The passport and merchandise are clearly identified as concepts while eligibility, fulfillment and checkout are implemented.

tabs.tab_title: Can I rely on this page for live hazard conditions?
tabs.tab_content: No. Consult official National Park Service condition and emergency notices before hiking, river travel or other risk-bearing activities.
